heading: Dissemination of research results
lead: The Director of the Institute shall disseminate the results of research conducted under section 285e–5 of this title and this section to appropriate professional entities and to the public.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 11242 of this title prior to renumbering by Pub. L. 100–607.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1988—Pub. L. 100–607, § 142(a), renumbered section 11242 of this title as this section. Pub. L. 100–607, § 142(d)(3), substituted “the Institute” for “the National Institute on Aging” and “section 285e–5 of this title and this section” for “this part”.
